ai_briefing.morning_summary: Crypto markets opened lower across the board, with Bitcoin down 1.1% and most altcoins slipping, reflecting renewed risk aversion amid geopolitical tensions and rising AI financing costs for miners. Negative headlines, including a drop in the Fear & Greed index and a costly XRP position by Evernorth, reinforce a cautious tone, though Solana’s treasury buying could provide sector support.
